name: chip-table
description: Poker chips for live games with real cards (web app) and Texas hold'em at a Telegram Mini App table (bot)

scripts.e2e: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/e2e.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/e2e-durak.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/e2e-admin.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/e2e-chess.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/e2e-checkers.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/e2e-nardy.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/e2e-solo.mjs
scripts.audit: node --test --test-timeout=240000 --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning bot/audit.*.test.js && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/fuzz-games.mjs all 7000 1 400 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/fuzz-privacy.mjs all 10
scripts.audit:long: AUDIT_STEPS=20000 AUDIT_EVAL=500000 AUDIT_ROLLS=3000000 AUDIT_SEEDS=40 node --test --test-timeout=3600000 --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning bot/audit.*.test.js && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/fuzz-games.mjs all 1000000 1000 400 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/fuzz-privacy.mjs all 1000 && node --expose-gc --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/load-ws.mjs 400 10
